title: Peace with God through faith
english: Therefore, having been justified out of faith, we have peace toward God through our Lord Jesus Christ. We glory in the hope of the glory of God; tribulation works patience (Romans 5:1-3).
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is quoting and briefly glossing Paul's words from Romans 5 about the results of justification by faith.

title: Sin and death through one man, grace through one Christ
english: Just as sin entered this world through one man, and death through sin, so also grace and gift abounded unto many through one Jesus Christ (Romans 5:12b-15). Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 14 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via tesseract OCR of Archive PDF; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Romans.
orientation: Origen is summarizing the contrast between Adam's transgression and the overflowing grace that comes through Jesus Christ.
